subject.title: feat(xiaomi): expose MiMo V2.5 on pay-as-you-go and default to mimo-v2.5

question: Should OpenClaw change both Xiaomi fresh/no-primary onboarding defaults to `mimo-v2.5`, or should this PR be narrowed to catalog-only PAYG V2.5 availability?
rationale: The implementation sits in the right plugin/docs/test boundary, but provider defaults affect fresh authenticated setup and model choice, which is a maintainer-owned product decision.

options.title: Sponsor V2.5 defaults
options.body: Accept the PR's default flip for fresh/no-primary Xiaomi pay-as-you-go and Token Plan setup and own the user-visible model-choice change.

options.title: Request catalog-only rows
options.body: Keep the PAYG V2.5 catalog/docs additions but revert the two default constant changes until a separate default decision lands.

options.title: Hold behind broader routing work
options.body: Pause this PR until the canonical Xiaomi V2.5 issue resolves whether catalog/default changes should land separately from multimodal routing.

recommendation.title: Sponsor V2.5 defaults
recommendation.body: Accept the PR's default flip for fresh/no-primary Xiaomi pay-as-you-go and Token Plan setup and own the user-visible model-choice change.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest prior owner for Xiaomi Token Plan V2.5 catalog/onboarding behavior adjacent to this default decision.
